name: balance_sheet_totals_by_root
query: SELECT root(account, 1) AS root, sum(cost(position)) AS total FROM OPEN ON 2016-01-01 CLOSE ON 2017-01-01 CLEAR GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
notes: Per root account at cost: income and expenses net to nothing after CLEAR, and the whole period balances at cost except for the zero-priced conversion entry.
